audit.why: 52.81% over 303 games. Skill-check levels 1-3 on her 1000-range Threaded Volley, then Annie from 4 once the stun-Tibbers threshold beats her HP and she has no hard escape.
Level 6 gives her Weaver's Wall (180s at rank 1) — map pressure, not lane defence — so the level 6 and first-item rows staying Annie is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Unraveled Earth only detonates on a dash or a knock-through, and Annie has neither.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit — 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Annie has no dash and Molten Shield's move-speed burst is not one, so the minefield is walkable ground for you. The stun only happens if Seismic Shove (14s at rank 1) throws you into it. Dodging one 14-second ability disarms her whole kill pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two texts credited Taliyah with escapes she does not have — 'kite to safety with Seismic Shove' and 'out of Q charges'.
audit.why: Seismic Shove displaces enemies, it is not her mobility; Threaded Volley has no charge system, it has Worked Ground. Her only self-mobility is Rock Surfing near walls plus Weaver's Wall.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[2].text rewritten around Rock Surfing.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Molten Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1 and it is the only way her mines ever reach you: Unraveled Earth detonates on a dash or a knock-through, and Annie has neither. Dodge the shove and her combo is dead for 14 seconds. - Molten Shield's speed burst is not a dash, so it never sets the mines off.

edits.before: The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Her mines only stun if she shoves you into them — you have no dash to set them off. Dodge the W and the burst is dead.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry by making the shove her only threat: dodge one 14s W and stun-Tibbers kills her before she reaches a wall.

edits.before: If Taliyah takes first blood, tighten up: Seismic Shove is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Taliyah takes first blood, respect Threaded Volley's 1000 range and farm the back of the wave. The shove is still the only thing that starts a kill on you — dodge it and a losing lane stays farmable on Q refunds.

edits.before: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, zone Taliyah off CS by existing, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.
edits.after: Ahead, hold the glow and stand clear of her wall lines: with the shove dodged she has no way to start, and Flash-Tibbers ends the recovery attempt.

edits.before: Deny her Seismic Shove knock-up setup by holding position
edits.after: Walk her minefield freely — only the shove can trigger it

edits.before: Taliyah's Threaded Volley poke and Seismic Shove displacement make early trades a skill check, but she has to commit to range to actually threaten you, giving you a window to punish with Disintegrate.
edits.after: Taliyah's Threaded Volley poke and the shove-into-mines setup make early trades a skill check, but Unraveled Earth only stuns if she knocks you into it, so dodge the 14s shove and step in with Disintegrate.

edits.before: With Luden's or Mask online you can burst her down through her shove-and-kite pattern before she ever gets to safety, since she has no hard escape once she's out of Q charges.
edits.after: With Luden's or Mask online you can burst her down through the shove-and-kite pattern before she reaches safety: her only escape is Rock Surfing wall speed, and mid lane gives her few walls to hug.

edits.before: First item favors you as your burst kills her before she can kite to safety with Seismic Shove
edits.after: First item favors you as your burst kills her before Rock Surfing wall speed carries her out of range
